claim: Historical test/source inventory. Current execution observations are in docs/VERIFICATION_STATUS.md. Full 95-scenario planning and unclosed assertions are in docs/planning/requirements-to-work.json. No full V1 acceptance is implied.

scenarios.assertion: Shop and OS authenticate, 40 products, modules and Coming Soon nav render
scenarios.note: Fresh database/apps/authentication setup and browser launch need integrated execution.

scenarios.assertion: Workspace A cannot read B contacts or assets even by guessed UUID
scenarios.note: Cross-tenant/role cases exist; no database execution claimed in this report.

scenarios.assertion: Masked credential metadata; no secret in API/browser/log
scenarios.note: Local AES-GCM development vault only; managed KMS/rotation remains an activation requirement.

scenarios.assertion: Service marked BLOCKED, other service statuses unaffected
scenarios.note: Rejected-service fixture is simulated; no authenticated supplier auth test observed.

scenarios.assertion: Staged rows, mapping version, variant candidates; no auto publish
scenarios.note: CSV parser/staging/mapping/review/commit implemented; persisted assertions await run.

scenarios.assertion: Rejected before entity resolution, no outbound fetch
scenarios.note: DTD/entity rejection implemented before source writes; network/security execution awaits run.

scenarios.assertion: Reject or dedupe, keep raw evidence and issues
scenarios.note: Malformed/duplicate staging cases exist; no silent source overwrite.

scenarios.assertion: Curated title preserved; merge review created
scenarios.note: Curated ownership and merge-review persistence cases await run.

scenarios.assertion: Visible circle corresponds to selected actual variant image, accessible label
scenarios.note: Allowlisted exact variant image/swatch projection covered in source; keyboard/UI selection needs browser evidence.

scenarios.assertion: Preview counts, authorization, revision and rollback manifest
scenarios.note: 100-product preview, approval, revision and rollback test written.

scenarios.assertion: Item quote-only; no unverified checkout price
scenarios.note: Unknown freight/currency/cost gates implemented; runtime checkout/UI needs integrated proof.

scenarios.assertion: Server rejects invalid quantity, accurate price tier recalculation
scenarios.note: MOQ, integer quantity, tier and server validation fixtures exist.

scenarios.assertion: Method/location incompatible choices disabled and server rejects bypass
scenarios.note: Dependent method/location and published rule bypass tests written; disabled UI affordances need browser evidence.

scenarios.assertion: Private original asset, versioned design, no exposed signed URL leak
scenarios.note: Private raster originals and scoped preview endpoint implemented; malware scanner intentionally NOT_CONFIGURED.

scenarios.assertion: One preset to eligible products, queued images, image/variant linkage
scenarios.note: Real synthetic raster render and exact variant/version linkage tested in source; large batch performance still unverified.

scenarios.assertion: Proof not production-ready; vendor dispatch blocked
scenarios.note: Low-DPI detection implemented; production expert/prepress verification absent and release remains blocked.

scenarios.assertion: Prior approval invalidated for changed revision
scenarios.note: Design revision supersedes exact proof hash/approval; persisted test awaits run.

scenarios.assertion: Source cost snapshot frozen and approval checks enforced
scenarios.note: Mixed RFQ/quote frozen source evidence workflow written; no live quote transmission.

scenarios.assertion: Approval required, audit who/why, no auto issue
scenarios.note: Margin floor and named reason/approval gates present; complete persisted evidence awaits run.

scenarios.assertion: Immutable lines, legal seller and art revision frozen
scenarios.note: Accepted order snapshot/seller/terms flow written with immutable records.

scenarios.assertion: One customer order, distinct jobs, provider POs and shipments
scenarios.note: Mixed order workflow creates distinct local jobs/POs/allocations; external outputs simulated.

scenarios.assertion: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; no duplicate submission until reconciliation
scenarios.note: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME blocks blind retries; supplier writes never activated.

scenarios.assertion: Customer sees partial fulfillment; tracking mapped to correct lines
scenarios.note: Partial quantity projection and shipment/order linkage fixtures present.

scenarios.assertion: Separate blank, decorator costs, operations and QC events
scenarios.note: Distinct outsourced labor/cost and QC gates exist; fully decorated ready-to-manufacture acceptance remains blocked by actual prepress requirements.

scenarios.assertion: Provider event reflected; simulated tracking not called live
scenarios.note: Mock routing/status only. No authenticated POD sandbox event is verified.

scenarios.assertion: Wrong buyer/budget/brand kit blocked on server
scenarios.note: Buyer, budget, brand and assigned-product checks enforced server-side; persisted tests await run.

scenarios.assertion: Correct campaign allocations and cutoff date with test clock
scenarios.note: Explicit-clock cutoff/allocation cases written; fundraiser settlement deliberately blocked.

scenarios.assertion: Each component mapped to correct source, plus kitting cost
scenarios.note: Component private source choices, per-SKU totals and separate packaging/assembly implemented; customer cost projection remains private/quote-first.

scenarios.assertion: External webhook dedupe, no duplicate payment settlement
scenarios.note: Signed/deduplicated local mock references only; no actual processor settlement or ledger sync.

scenarios.assertion: Actual versus estimated landed cost, profit/owner hour report
scenarios.note: Profit arithmetic and persisted time/report lineage cases written; no financial settlement claims.

scenarios.assertion: Contact permission, campaign publishing approval and attribution
scenarios.note: Affirmative consent, local publication approval/replay and no-send checks written.

scenarios.assertion: Event/filter/action simulation shows intended effects, no side effects
scenarios.note: Dry-run count invariance, safe AST/cycle checks and idempotent task effect cases written.

scenarios.assertion: UI shows unsupported capability; permits file/manual fallback
scenarios.note: Unsupported proprietary APIs and ASI without authorized schemas remain blocked; file fallback supported.

scenarios.assertion: Disallowed private host and redirect rejected
scenarios.note: HTTPS allowlist/private DNS/redirect rejection implemented; real egress hardening review still required.

scenarios.assertion: Signed event accepted once; invalid/replayed ignored and logged
scenarios.note: Signature/age/payload and local replay cases; vendor-specific webhooks unverified.

scenarios.assertion: All deferred routes visible only as truthful, disabled placeholders
scenarios.note: Registry/backend activation gate implemented. All placeholder route buttons still need browser audit.

scenarios.assertion: Search/filter/configurator usable with keyboard and mobile viewport
scenarios.note: Keyboard/mobile/axe test execution has not been observed. Required for acceptance.

scenarios.assertion: Stale status displays, storefront retains last safe published revision
scenarios.note: Last-safe public snapshot and failed sync retention cases written.

scenarios.assertion: Backup restored into fresh staging environment; tenant counts match
scenarios.note: A fresh restore with tenant count comparison has not been observed. Do not mark complete.

scenarios.assertion: One documented setup creates usable demo without existing vendor account
scenarios.note: Fresh-checkout setup and launch verification still required; no vendor account needed for local mode.
